college_admission_core.description: Synthetic College Admission CGPR team decision task at p=0.5, delta=0.25, alpha=0.9. Reference values are from the authors' released College Admission imperfect-human synthetic output for this setting.

team_accuracy.description: Final human-AI team decision accuracy under the CGPR team-decision rule.

reliance_probability.description: Probability proxy for humans accepting AI advice in the aligned region.

ai_accuracy.description: Diagnostic standalone AI prediction accuracy before human reliance is applied; reported by train/test slices but not used in the gym score.

complementary_region_accuracy.description: Diagnostic AI accuracy on the regime where human predictions are weaker; reported by train/test slices but not used in the gym score.

routing_accuracy.description: Agreement between an explicit adaptive route choice and the synthetic region label; missing route outputs score zero.
